Kabhi mujhe yaad kar, kabhi meri khamoshi ko padh, Kabhi meri jagah khud ko rakh kar dekh. Ek baar us ek saal ko meri nazron se dekh, Jahan maine bina kisi umeed ke tujhe apna waqt, apna pyaar, apna sukoon, apna har mumkin saath diya. Jab tujhe support chahiye tha, main tha, Jab tujhe kisi ki zarurat thi, main tha, Jab tu khud se lad rahi thi, main tere saath khada tha. Maine kabhi tere har pal ka hisaab nahi maanga, Kabhi tere diye hue pyaar ko tol kar nahi dekha. Lekin mere hisse mein kya aaya? Kabhi meri baat samjhe bina faisla, Kabhi mere lafzon ka galat matlab, Kabhi tere doubts, jinhe tune mujhse kehne ke bajaye apne andar hi rakh kar hum dono ke beech faasle bana diye. Kabhi mera dil teri baaton ne toda, kabhi teri harkaton ne. Kabhi block, unblock aur ignore karke, kabhi dusron ki baaton mein aakar mere saath aisa bartav karke vo dard main tujhe shayad kabhi samjha hi nahi saka aur nahi tu samaj payi . Kabhi meri zarurat ke waqt mujhe akela chhod diya, kabhi tere harsh lafzon ne mujhe andar tak chot di, kabhi meri feelings ko samjhe bina mujhe judge kiya, kabhi mujhe blame kiya, kabhi mujhe aise adhura chhod diya jaise meri feelings ka koi matlab hi nahi tha. Aur June ka woh ek hafta bhi main kaise bhool jaun? Un shaadi ke dino mein jo kuch hua, us waqt mera overthinking, mera dard, meri insecurity— shayad tujhe kuch bhi samajh nahi aaya. Main andar se itna kuch feel kar raha tha, lekin mujhe hi bura-bhala kaha gaya. Mujhse baatein chhupayi gayi, mujhse jhooth bola gaya, aur jab main kuch poochta tha toh kabhi ek insaan ki baat kuch aur hoti thi, kabhi kisi doosre ki kuch aur. Aur sabse zyada dard is baat ka tha ki un logon ke liye tune mujhse bina respect ke baat ki, mujhse rude hui, mujhe harshly handle kiya, mujhe ignore kiya, aur mana karne ke baad bhi mujhse jhooth bola. Main ye nahi keh raha ki us waqt tujhe koi hurt nahi hua tha. Hua tha. Lekin sach kahun toh us waqt jitna tu meri wajah se hurt hui, usse kai guna zyada main andar se hurt hua tha. Farq bas itna tha ki tu apna dard dikha rahi thi, aur main apna dard samjhate-samjhate khud ko hi andar se tod raha tha. Tere us waqt ke words aur actions sirf us waqt khatam nahi hue. Woh mere thoughts mein adhure reh gaye. Aaj bhi kabhi-kabhi koi waise hi words, waisa hi behaviour ya koi similar situation hoti hai, toh mera dimaag usi jagah wapas chala jata hai. Ab kabhi-kabhi mujhe khud samajh nahi aata ki mujhe cheezein itni strongly kyun hit karti hain. Koi simple sa word ya action hota hai, aur mera dimaag kharab hone lagta hai, sar dard hone lagta hai, overthinking shuru ho jaati hai. Mujhe nahi pata ise kya naam doon. Bas itna pata hai ki main us sab ko abhi tak poori tarah peeche nahi chhod paya hoon. Main tujhe ye sab ginti ya hisaab ke liye nahi bata raha. Tu keh sakti hai, “Maine kabhi kuch gina hi nahi.” Aur shayad tune nahi gina hoga. Lekin maine bhi kabhi nahi gina. Main bas apna woh emotion bata raha hoon jahan dheere-dheere main khud ko hi kho raha tha. Main tujhe kitni baar explanation deta raha, kitni baar samjhata raha, kitni baar jabki dard mujhe hua tha, phir bhi main tujhe manane lagta tha. Jab tujhe apni kisi baat ka regret hota, main tujhe bas itna kehkar chhod deta tha— “Agli baar aisa mat karna.” Main us waqt bhi tere khilaaf nahi khada hota tha, kyunki mujhe tera regret dekhkar tera dard zyada important lagta tha. Lekin wahi cheezein baar-baar repeat hoti gayi, aur main har baar thoda aur bikhar tha gaya. Pehle GC ke waqt main toota, phir GC ke andar jo hua us wakt toota, phir Vicky ki wajah se main toota, phir teri baaton ne toda, phir tere career aur life ko lekar confusion ke beech main khud ko kahin kho baitha. Kabhi bina wajah ke kayi baar behes mere saat kiya gaya , kabhi mujhe harshly handle kiya gaya, kabhi meri baat samjhe bina mujhe judge kiya gaya, kabhi mujhe blame kiya gaya, kabhi meri zarurat ke waqt mujhe ignore kiya gaya, aur kabhi dusron ki wajah se mujhe dard diya gaya. Aur main? Main har baar samjhata raha. Har baar explain karta raha. Har baar cheezein theek karne ki koshish karta raha. Lekin har dard sehne ki bhi ek hadd hoti hai. Kuch raaton mein main so nahi paya, kuch waqt aisa tha jab khana tak theek se nahi kha paya. Kabhi overthinking ne dimag ko chain nahi lene diya, kabhi insecurity ne andar se hila diya, kabhi aankhon mein aansu aa gaye, aur kabhi bas chup reh gaya. Main tujhe ye isliye nahi bata raha ki tu guilty feel kare. Main bas chahta hoon ki ek baar tu samjhe ki tere liye shayad kuch pal the, lekin mere liye woh pal mere andar reh gaye. Aur sabse ajeeb baat ye hai— main tujhe har baar samjhata raha, jabki dard mujhe hua tha. Har baar apna dard peeche rakhkar pehle tujhe samjha, pehle tujhe calm kiya, pehle tujhe maaf kiya. Aur dheere-dheere ek din aisa aaya jab main itna bikhar gaya ki mujhe khud samajh nahi aaya main khud ko kahan kho chuka hoon. Shayad isi liye tu kabhi mujhe poori tarah samajh nahi payi— kyunki main tujhe apna dard dikhane se pehle tera dard samajhne lagta tha. Kabhi ek baar yaad karna jabse tu meri zindagi mein aayi june -2025 se leke July-2026 tak kya-kya hua. Mere dimaag mein sab kuch kabhi seedha nahi tha. Jaise eenton se bani koi deewar ho, lekin har brick ke beech ajeeb sa gap, koi unknown pattern, koi missing piece. Teri baatein, tere actions, tere tareeqe— sab usi tarah mere dimaag mein jama hote gaye. Kuch samajh aaya, kuch nahi aaya, kuch ka jawab mila, kuch bina jawab ke reh gaya. Lekin August-2026 se shayad pehli baar kuch cheezein dheere-dheere brick by brick apni jagah banane lagi hain. tere baatein aur tere tarikhe aur bina puche samjana aur mujse pehle mera soch ko samajna aur mujse pehle vo chij ko thik se batana aur mujse pehle tu hi clear karna kahi mai kuch na sochu aur wagera wagera Shayad isi liye main khud ko heal karna chahta hoon. Dubara apne aap ko samajhna chahta hoon. Dubara apne dimaag mein woh pattern banana chahta hoon jahan har cheez itni unknown na lage. Isi liye maine tujhe kaha tha— mujhe dobara wahi words aur wahi actions mat dikhana. Kyuki kuch cheezein sirf us waqt hurt nahi karti, woh purani saari cheezein dobara yaad dila deti hain. Phir overthinking shuru hoti hai, dimag heavy ho jata hai, sar dard hone lagta hai, aur main phir wahi purani jagah pahunch jata hoon jahan se nikalne ki koshish kar raha hoon. Bas mujhe dobara mat todna. Main khud ko heal karne ka faisla kar chuka hoon. Agar main theek ho gaya, toh main tere saath pehle se zyada sukoon se reh paunga. Lekin agar main phir wahi bikhar gaya, toh mujhe khud nahi pata main kal kis haal mein rahunga aur kitna sambhal paunga. Aur ek baat yaad rakhna— Har baar koi insaan tumhare paas wapas aaye, iska matlab ye nahi ki uske paas self-respect nahi hai. Kabhi-kabhi iska matlab sirf itna hota hai ki woh rishta chhodne se pehle apni taraf se har koshish kar raha tha. Lekin ek waqt aata hai jab insaan doosre ko nahi, khud ko hi kho deta hai. Isliye situation ko wahan tak mat le jaana jahan mujhe tumse nahi, khud se hi door hona pade. Aur kabhi sach mein samajhna ho na mujhe, toh meri baaton ka hisaab mat karna. Bas ek baar poora saal meri aankhon se dekhna. Phir shayad tujhe khud samajh aa jayega— main kitni baar toota tha, kitni baar chup raha tha, aur har baar phir bhi tere saamne khada kyun tha.
Dear Gudiya, Mujhe pata hai, tu mujhe dil se chahti hai. Aur main ye letter isliye nahi likh raha ki tere pyaar ko question karun. Kabhi nahi. Maine tera pyaar mehsoos kiya hai. Maine dekha hai tu mere liye kitna feel karti hai, kitna sochti hai, kitna overthink karti hai. Mujhe pata hai kuch raaton mein tu bhi theek se so nahi paayi, kuch baaton ka tujhe bhi regret hua, tu bhi hurt hui, aur kai baar tune bhi khud se bahut kuch kaha hoga. Mujhe ye bhi pata hai ki main tere liye kitna matter karta hoon. Tu mujhe khone se darti hai. Tu mujhse baat karke khush hoti hai. Kabhi-kabhi mujhse baat karte hue tu apna waqt tak bhool jaati hai. Aur shayad isi liye, itna kuch hone ke baad bhi maine tujhe kabhi chhoda nahi. Kyuki mujhe tere andar ka woh pyaar hamesha dikhta raha. Main maanta hoon ki tu mujhse pyaar karti hai. Main us pyaar ko mehsoos karta hoon. Aur shayad tu ye nahi jaanti ki main tujhe kitna chahta hoon. Main tujhe sirf un achhe palon mein nahi chahta jab sab kuch theek hota hai. Main tujhe un palon mein bhi chahta hoon jab hum dono confuse hote hain, jab baatein samajh nahi aati, jab dono hurt hote hain, aur jab relationship ko samajhne ke liye thoda rukna padta hai. Tere saath mera attachment sirf baaton tak nahi raha. Meri aadaton mein tu aa gayi. Meri soch mein tu aa gayi. Mere din ke chhote-chhote moments mein tu aa gayi. Isliye jab tu khush hoti hai, mujhe bhi genuinely achha lagta hai. Jab tu pareshan hoti hai, mera dil bhi usse ignore nahi kar pata. Aur mujhe pata hai, tu bhi future ko lekar mere saath bahut kuch sochti hai. Tu chahti hai ki ek din apni shaadi ho. Apna ghar ho. Apne bachche ho. Apni ek family ho. Aur zindagi ke aakhri waqt tak hum dono ek dusre ke saath khade rahein. Ye chhoti baat nahi hai. Kisi ko apne future ka itna bada hissa samajhna, uske saath poori zindagi imagine karna — usmein bahut gehra pyaar hota hai. Aur shayad isi wajah se main bhi is rishte ko itni aasani se chhod nahi paaya. Kyuki mere liye tu sirf meri zindagi ka ek chapter nahi hai. Tu woh insaan hai jiske saath maine apne kal ke baare mein sochna seekha. Lekin ab main ek aur cheez samajh raha hoon. Pyaar sirf kisi ko pakad kar rakhne ka naam nahi hai. Kabhi-kabhi pyaar ka matlab khud ko bhi samajhna hota hai. God ne shayad mujhe itni samajh di hai ki main ab apne andar ki kuch cheezon ko dekh sakun. Jo hua usse samajh sakun. Jo mujhe hurt karta raha, usse heal kar sakun. Main purani baaton ko lekar tujhe saza nahi dena chahta. Main bas un baaton se khud ko azaad karna chahta hoon. Main dobara theek hona chahta hoon. Aur jab main theek hounga, toh main tere pyaar ko aur achhe se feel kar paunga — bina har purani baat ko aaj ke beech laaye. Main tere pyaar ko kam nahi kar raha. Main tujhse door jaane ki baat nahi kar raha. Main bas chahta hoon ki jo hum dono ke beech itna pyaar hai, woh purani misunderstandings ke neeche daba na rahe. Main chahta hoon ki ek din jab hum peeche mudkar is sab ko dekhein, toh humein sirf ye yaad aaye ki hum dono ne kitna kuch samjha, kitna kuch seekha, aur phir bhi ek dusre ka haath nahi chhoda. Mujhe nahi pata future mein har cheez exactly kaisi hogi. Lekin itna zaroor pata hai— Main tujhe bahut chahta hoon. Itna ki tere saath sirf aaj ki baatein nahi, kal ki zindagi bhi sochta hoon. Teri khushi mere liye matter karti hai. Tera sukoon mere liye matter karta hai. Tera pyaar mere liye matter karta hai. Aur sabse zyada, tu mere liye matter karti hai. Isliye agar kabhi tujhe lage ki main kuch cheezon ko lekar ruk raha hoon, soch raha hoon, ya khud ko heal kar raha hoon, toh usse mere pyaar ki kami mat samajhna. Kabhi-kabhi insaan jis rishte ko sabse zyada bachana chahta hai, uske liye pehle khud ko sambhalta hai. Main bhi wahi kar raha hoon. Khud ko sambhal raha hoon. Taaki jo pyaar main tere liye rakhta hoon, woh sirf lafzon mein nahi, balki ek din poori sukoon bhari zindagi mein bhi nazar aaye. Aur agar kabhi tu bhool jaaye ki tu mere liye kya hai— Toh bas itna yaad rakhna: Maine tera pyaar dekha hai. Maine tera pyaar mehsoos kiya hai. Aur maine tujhe jitna chaaha hai, shayad utna lafzon mein kabhi poora bata bhi nahi paunga.
-- Irfan
